tagline: Code, dependency, and container scans for remote teammates — auth and policy changes need your approval.
requirements: Run `snyk auth` on the host or set SNYK_TOKEN for project scans; static analysis tools work without an account. This is Snyk's official MCP mode of their CLI, launched via the `mcp` subcommand.

tools.name: snyk_code_scan
tools.note: Static analysis of local source code.

tools.name: snyk_container_scan
tools.note: Scans a container image for vulnerabilities.

tools.name: snyk_aibom
tools.note: Generates an AI bill of materials.

tools.name: snyk_package_health_check
tools.note: Reports health signals for a package.

tools.name: snyk_breakability_check
tools.note: Checks whether an upgrade breaks the build.

tools.name: snyk_secret_scan
tools.note: Finds hardcoded secrets — findings may quote the secret text.

tools.name: snyk_trust
tools.note: Marks packages or sources as trusted — a policy change.

seo.description: Share the official Snyk MCP server with MCPWire. Let teammates run code, dependency, and container scans over P2P, and keep authentication and trust changes behind approval.
